tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied similar items such as CABLE JOINTING MATERIALS in a single year of value Rs. 0.92 Lakhs to any Generating Power Houses/Major Industries/Public Sector Undertaking/Power utilities in the preceding five financial years (2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall furnish single PO. Weightage will considered as per the KTPP act. If a bidder submits the Previous PO of private Industry then it is mandatory to furnish corresponding Invoice copy.

The bidder shall have a minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs. 1.84 Lakhs during any two years in the preceding 5 financial years ( 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall furnish Profit & Loss account statement or Turn over Certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant. Weightage will considered as per the KTPP act
